_id.description: Unique MongoDB primary key identifier (ObjectId or hex string)

case_id.description: Relational foreign key string referencing cases.case_id (e.g. CASE-2026-001)

document_type.description: Document category determining dynamic payload structure (e.g. Witness statements, CCTV metadata, PDF reports, Email archives)

title.description: Descriptive title of the intelligence document

content.description: Full-text textual narrative, statement, transcript, or raw dump

summary.description: Executive summary of the intelligence item

source_type.description: Operational origin (Field Interview, Formal Filing, Sensor Telemetry, OSINT, Technical Intercept)

source_name.description: Specific reporting device, agent, station, or agency log reference

related_entity_ids.description: Polymorphic references to relational entities (person, vehicle, device, location, officer)

tags.description: Keywords and indexing tags for rapid filtering and text search

metadata.description: Polymorphic key-value payload storing domain-specific attributes (audio refs, camera IDs, EXIF, packet hashes)

document_status.description: Verification state (Verified, Pending Authentication, Classified, Unverified)

created_at.description: Timestamp when document was acquired or recorded (ISO string or BSON Date)

ingested_at.description: Timestamp when document was ingested into the MongoDB repository
